--- a/api/routes/books.py
+++ b/api/routes/books.py
@@ -11,7 +11,6 @@ from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
 from typing import Optional
 import requests
 from sqlalchemy import or_, func
-import unicodedata
 from api.extensions import cache
 from api.book_provider import BookProvider
 from api.isbn import isbn_lookup_values
@@ -257,41 +256,28 @@ def get_books():
     if query_author:
         books = books.filter(Books.author==query_author)
 
-    def _shelf_sort_key(value):
-        # Article-insensitive, accent-folded key so the list matches the order a
-        # reader scanning the shelf expects. SQL lower() files "The Hobbit" under
-        # "T" and orders accented titles by raw code point; normalize here instead
-        # so pagination is stable against the shelf rather than raw column bytes.
-        text = (value or "").strip().lower()
-        for article in ("the ", "a ", "an "):
-            if text.startswith(article):
-                text = text[len(article):]
-                break
-        decomposed = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)
-        return "".join(ch for ch in decomposed if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
-
-    def _rank(b):
-        if sort_by == "progress":
-            return (b.current_page * 100.0 / b.total_pages) if b.total_pages else 0.0
-        if sort_by == "created_on":
-            return b.created_on
-        return _shelf_sort_key(getattr(b, sort_by))
-
-    per_page = int(limit)
-    ranked = sorted(books.all(), key=_rank, reverse=(order == "desc"))
-    total_items = len(ranked)
-    total_pages = (total_items + per_page - 1) // per_page if per_page else 0
-    start = (offset - 1) * per_page
-    page_items = ranked[start:start + per_page]
-
-    return jsonify({"items": books_schema.dump(page_items), "meta": {
-            "page": offset,
-            "per_page": per_page,
-            "total_items": total_items,
-            "total_pages": total_pages,
-            "has_next": offset < total_pages,
-            "has_prev": offset > 1,
-            "offset": (offset - 1) * per_page
+    if sort_by == "progress":
+      sort_field = (Books.current_page * 100.0 / Books.total_pages).label('progress')
+    elif sort_by == "created_on":
+      sort_field = Books.created_on
+    else:
+      sort_field = func.lower(getattr(Books, sort_by))
+
+    if order == "asc":
+      books = books.order_by(sort_field.asc())
+    else:    
+     books = books.order_by(sort_field.desc())
+
+    books = books.paginate(page=offset, per_page=limit, error_out=False)
+
+    return jsonify({"items": books_schema.dump(books.items), "meta": {
+            "page": books.page,
+            "per_page": books.per_page,
+            "total_items": books.total,
+            "total_pages": books.pages,
+            "has_next": books.has_next,
+            "has_prev": books.has_prev,
+            "offset": (books.page - 1) * books.per_page
         }})
 
 @books_endpoint.route("/v1/books", methods=["POST"])
